name: Anne Neurath
source:
Passenger of the first class noontime car.
A close friend of Marine's and a first-class dancer. She was Val's lover. She is a very strong-willed and auspicious woman. She is the opposite of the motherly Marine, but perhaps that is why they can be best friends.
She is fed up with being forced by Francis to accompany him on his prenuptial trip. A few days ago, Marine began to speak and act as if Val were right in front of her. Francis is half in a panic when he sees her like this, but Anne is not worried. Anne is not worried, because the Marine she sees now is exactly the same as she was when Val was alive.
For Anne, this trip was nothing more than an awkward lover's quarrel between the couple. She had been friends with Val before his death because of her work. She had a faint crush on Val, who entertained her with his witty banter, and once crossed the line and slept with him. Although Anne did not tell Marine, Val was quite a playboy before his death. Anne was not the only one he had affairs with.
If, indeed, Val's ghost exists, it must be stalking Marine with a mixture of good and bad intentions. Anne, as Marine's best friend, is angry with Val for coming back now.
